sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 660. Success value 100. 4x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 180% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 100% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 150 seconds: Recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability.
-Target: yourself. Applies Crimson King's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases all stats by 50%, increases all stats for all allies by 50%. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Removes 50 Cost.
Water and Wind Defense from Unison Damage +700
